text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["((df['proto'] == 'tcp') | ((df['swin'] == 0) & (df['dwin'] == 0) & (df['stcpb'] == 0) & (df['dtcpb'] == 0) & (df['tcprtt'] == 0) & (df['synack'] == 0) & (df['ackdat'] == 0)))"],"features":["proto","swin","dwin","stcpb","dtcpb","tcprtt","synack","ackdat"],"rationale":"TCP window advertisements, sequence numbers, and TCP handshake timings are unavailable for non-TCP flows and are represented as zero."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["((df['proto'] == 'tcp') | ((df['is_ftp_login'] == 0) & (df['ct_ftp_cmd'] == 0)))"],"features":["proto","is_ftp_login","ct_ftp_cmd"],"rationale":"FTP login and command features cannot be present on a non-TCP flow because FTP uses TCP."}]}
